label: Chapter 22
english: When the irascible part of our soul (thumikon) seizes some excuse and is troubled, then the demons suggest to us how good it is to withdraw into solitude thus keeping us from resolving the cause of the gloominess and freeing ourselves from the disturbance.

But when our desiring part (eipithumetikon) is enkindled, then they make us sociable and call us hardened and uncivil, so that by desiring bodies we then come into contact with bodies. We should not obey them, but instead do the opposite.
